name: Work Hard
overview: Scripture emphasizes the value of diligence and hard work as foundational to provision and success, contrasting it with the consequences of laziness and folly. The Proverbs passages teach that diligent effort leads to wealth, satisfaction, and influence, while slackness results in poverty, want, and subjugation. Labor is portrayed as inherently profitable, whereas idle talk and following empty pursuits lead to lack and failure. This biblical perspective calls believers to embrace faithful, consistent work as a reflection of wise stewardship and trust in God’s provision.
